# Cannot reproduce branches

`customer_support.pb.root_cause_analysis.cannot_reproduce_branches` · v1.0.0 · **draft** · scope **capability** · kind **playbook**

> When it will not reproduce, branch rather than stop. Split into environmental (something in their setup we do not have), intermittent (state, timing or ordering), data-dependent (their records, not ours), and misdescribed (they did something other than what they reported) — and take the different next step each demands.

Cannot-reproduce is a strong finding: it has already eliminated the entire class of deterministic universal faults. Recording it as a close reason throws that elimination away and guarantees the next occurrence starts from nothing.
